items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Some pianist, but the name of May, that lives uptown around Jackson.

ctx.x: She has a big beat. Yeah, he's a big beat. Yeah.

She was also an organist. At first, Harold Dejean, I thought that was May someone. I forget her last name. Oh. Some pianist, but the name of May, that lives uptown around Jackson. So I thought maybe we'd get to talk to her. Oh, yeah, yeah. But if she's dead, of course, we'll never get to see her. I thought it'd be interesting to have her name down right and know how to spell it.
Yeah, she was also an organist. She was our organist at St. Catharine Church. At the church. Oh, for me.
